preparation.closure: Implicit closing segment; endpoint not duplicated
preparation.traversal: Clockwise, negative signed area; first minimum position
preparation.scaling: Resampled extrema renormalised to ASSUMED stroke and load range
preparation.card_space: ASSUMED pump-card shapes; source does not specify surface or pump

excluded_labels.PLUNGER_UNDERTRAVEL: Default cards duplicate NORMAL; a distinguishing matched-travel basis is required before synthetic training or benchmark scoring.
excluded_labels.TUBING_MOVEMENT: Default load differences from NORMAL are below the configured noise scale; a distinguishing basis is required before synthetic training or benchmark scoring.

field_accuracy.reason: Independent labelled, dimensioned field cards are unavailable

limitations: n = 10: eight literal plus two ASSUMED crosswalks; one exemplar per class.
Wilson 95 % intervals are wide; plate counts are not field accuracy.
The plate is NOT independent of training: test_card_generator_shapes.py constrains generators to it.
Consistency with dependent public shapes is an upper indication at best.
Normalised axes have no engineering units; all physical scales are ASSUMED.
Pump-card interpretation is ASSUMED; the source does not specify card space.
Modes without plate exemplars are unscored; synthetic CV is not field validation.
